crossRefs.note: Then there arose a great cry of the people and of their wives against their brothers the Jews.
He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your…
and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands…
that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than…
Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;
Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.
